JOB PURPOSE:

To act as a Senior Consultant responsible for leading ERP projects, managing system changes, and serving as a process expert to ensure ERP solutions are designed, implemented, and continuously improved in alignment with business objectives, industry best practices, and enterprise standards. The role ensures stable operations, effective change adoption, and optimized end-to-end business processes across the organization.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:
• Lead and manage end to end ERP initiatives including system implementations, enhancements, rollouts, and upgrades.
• Act as the primary ERP subject matter expert during project lifecycle phases (initiation, design, build, test, deploy, and Post Go live support).
• Coordinate with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to ensure timely and quality delivery of ERP projects.
• Ensure project scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks are actively managed and communicated.
• Support the reporting manager in the design, standardization, automation, and optimization of ERP enabled business processes.
• Ensure ERP processes are aligned with enterprise standards, internal controls, and best practices.
• Monitor process effectiveness on a day to day basis and recommend corrective or preventive actions where required.
• Manage ERP change requests, ensuring proper impact assessment, prioritization, approvals, testing, and deployment.
• Ensure system changes are implemented in a controlled manner without disrupting business operations.
• Support governance frameworks for ERP changes using approved tools and methodologies.
• Ensure compliance with all relevant ERP policies, procedures, and system governance standards.
• Contribute to cost-effective utilization of ERP systems and resources, reducing rework, inefficiencies, and unnecessary customizations.
• Ensure system documentation, process flows, and functional specifications are maintained and up to date.
• Ensure ERP services meet defined quality standards and business requirements.
• Proactively identify opportunities to enhance system performance, usability, and process efficiency.
• Recommend and implement approved system or process improvements based on operational insights, industry trends, and business needs.
• Act as a trusted advisor to business users on ERP capabilities and optimal system usage.
• Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives within ERP processes, systems, and service delivery.
• Promote standardization and simplification of processes across functions and entities.
• Support the organization's digital transformation and long-term ERP roadmap.
• Engage effectively with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into ERP solutions.
• Work closely with implementation partners and support vendors to ensure service quality, accountability, and knowledge transfer.
• Review vendor deliverables and ensure adherence to agreed scope and standards.
• Ensure ERP solutions and processes support compliance, auditability, and risk management requirements.
• Support business change adoption by contributing to training, communication, and user readiness activities.
• Demonstrate adaptability during organizational and system changes and actively participate in change initiatives, programs, and projects aligned with international best practices.

Education / Qualifications
• Required: Bachelor's degree in computer information systems, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering.

Certifications:
• SAP Certifications or equivalent ERP
• Six sigma
• ITLT

Experience
• Required: 5-7 years

Job purpose:

The expert Oracle ERP application developer will design, develop, enhance, and support Oracle E-Business Suite (R12.2.x) applications. The role requires strong technical skills in Oracle ERP, Oracle APEX, and Oracle OAF, in addition to advanced PL/SQL and integration knowledge. The developer will collaborate with functional teams, deliver high-quality solutions, and provide technical leadership within the ERP environment.

1- Application development & customization

• Develop and customize Oracle ERP (R12.2.x) components using:

• Oracle APEX (mandatory)

• Oracle OAF (mandatory)

• Oracle Forms, Reports (10g/12c) and BI Publisher

• Oracle Workflow Builder

• Create and maintain:

• PL/SQL packages, functions, procedures, and APIs

• Reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions (RICE)

• Custom concurrent programs

• Support development for new modules, system enhancements, and upgrades.

2- Functional & technical support

• Provide technical support for key Oracle ERP modules such as:

• Financials: AP, AR, GL, FA

• Supply Chain: PO, INV, OM

• HRMS/Payroll (as applicable)

• Troubleshoot system issues and provide timely resolutions.

• Analyze business requirements and design scalable solutions.

• Support patching, cloning, and maintenance tasks during R12.2 online patching (adop).

3- Integration & APIs

• Develop integrations using:

• REST/SOAP web services

• Oracle public APIs & interface tables

• Develop secure data exchange processes with external systems (APEX/OAF-based solutions included).

4- Performance & quality assurance

• Conduct PL/SQL optimization and tuning.

• Perform code reviews and ensure compliance with EBS development standards.

• Prepare technical documents: MD050, MD070, TE020, and deployment guides.

5- Collaboration & leadership

• Work closely with functional consultants and technical teams.

• Mentor junior developers and ensure use of best practices.

• Participate actively in system design and architecture discussions.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field.

Experience

• 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience in Oracle ERP application development (R12.1/R12.2).

• Strong experience in Oracle E-Business Suite R12.2.x, including online patching.

Mandatory technical skills

• Oracle APEX – advanced development

• Oracle OAF – customizations & extensions

• PL/SQL (expert-level)

• Oracle Forms / Reports

• BI Publisher & XML Publisher

• Oracle Workflow

• Unix/Linux shell scripting

• Understanding of EBS architecture, file system, patches, and adop cycles

Preferred skills

• Knowledge of:

• Oracle SOA / Integration Cloud (OIC)

• REST/SOAP API integration

• Oracle ADF

• Version control (Git/SVN)

• Experience working in Agile environments.

Behavioural competencies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Leadership and mentoring capabilities.

• Strong ownership and commitment to quality.

EY Riyadh is seeking an experienced Technology Consulting professional to help clients design, implement and optimize Oracle solutions that drive business value. You will work on complex transformation programs across industries, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver client outcomes.

The role emphasizes strong stakeholder management, English fluency, and the ability to translate business needs into practical Oracle-based solutions within EY's consulting framework.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

To lead and optimize maintenance planning and scheduling processes, ensuring reliability and efficiency of assets, while mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement in a gasification and power production facility.

JOB OBJECTIVES

1. Optimize Asset Management Processes: To analyze, design, and improve end‑to‑end enterprise asset management processes (maintenance planning, work management, asset lifecycle, spare parts management). Ensure best‑practice alignment with organizational standards and operational strategy.

2. Support and enhance the EAM System: To configure, maintain, and enhance EAM modules to support maintenance, reliability, and operations. Ensures accurate and efficient system functionality to meet business requirements. Manage system upgrades, enhancements, and data integrity. This includes equipment and functional location master data, maintenance notifications and work orders, preventive maintenance plans and task lists, Maintenance scheduling and execution

3. Partner With Business Stakeholders: To engage with maintenance, reliability, engineering, supply chain, EHSS, operations, and finance teams to understand requirements. Translates business needs into functional specifications and workable system solutions. Serves as a bridge between technical teams (developers/IT) and end‑users. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system integration (e.g., SAP MM, QM, CO, HR).

4. Drive Master Data Excellence: To ensure high-quality master data for equipment, functional locations, BOMs, task lists, and maintenance plans. Supports data governance, validation, and continuous improvement of asset data. Support S/4HANA migrations and Fiori app enablement (if applicable).

5. Improve Maintenance Planning & Scheduling Efficiency: To support the creation, optimization, and automation of maintenance plans and work orders. Introduces best practices in preventive, predictive, and reliability‑centered maintenance. Customizes PM module settings in SAP via SPRO.

6. Support Change Management & User Adoption: To develop training materials and conduct training sessions for maintenance and operations users. Promotes standardization and consistent use of EAM processes across sites. Provides system support, troubleshooting, and guidance to end-users. Creates and maintain technical documentation, process flows, and training materials.

7. Enable Reporting and Performance Analytics: To build dashboards, KPIs, and reports for maintenance performance (availability, reliability, cost, backlog, compliance). Enables data-driven decision-making across maintenance and asset management functions. Performs data migration using LSMW, BAPIs, or BDCs. Works with ABAP developers to define functional specs for custom reports or enhancements. Monitors and resolve tickets in support systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy, JIRA).

8. Ensure Compliance & Audit Readiness: To ensure maintenance documentation, work processes, and asset information are compliant with corporate standards and regulatory requirements. Supports internal/external audits related to asset management systems.

9. Contribute to Continuous Improvement and Digital Transformation: To Support new technologies such as mobile maintenance, IoT sensors, predictive maintenance, and integrated digital workflows. Drives continuous improvement initiatives to increase asset reliability and reduce downtime.

Support Project Delivery: To participate in or lead EAM-related projects (system rollouts, process redesign, upgrades, integrations). Ensures timely delivery of project tasks, documentation, and testing.

Formal Qualifications/Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information system or equivalent - Essential

SAP PM Certification: Certified SF PM/EAM Consultant - Essential

Advanced certifications or masteral in IT Management preferred - Preferred

Job Related Work Experience

8-12 Years of work experience as SAP PM Consultant working with ERP teams supporting the effective management of plant maintenance activities through SAP working as SAP Plant Maintenance module (PM) in medium / large firm. - Essential

Experience in configuring, customizing, and supporting the SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) module, including integration with MM, QM, CO, and other relevant modules. - Essential
